text:
maria-ps: Heads-up — I sketched a cross-account auth proposal for the Snowbridge connector so partners (Snowflake, Databricks, vector DBs) can onboard without sharing raw keys. TL;DR: use short-lived OIDC tokens + per-tenant service principals + a small proxy for auditable tmp creds. Proposal doc: https://redwood.share/proposals/snowbridge-cc-auth (WIP) :page_facing_up:

alex-eng: Nice. Quick Q: how do we handle Databricks PAT rotation? Can we map it into an OIDC flow or do we need a token-exchange sidecar?

maria-ps: Great question. For Databricks the plan is token-exchange sidecar that mints a short-lived token after validating partner OIDC. That avoids storing long-lived PATs inside our tenant config.

tao-plat: Important: the sidecar must be deployable in partner VPC for Private customers. Also need a minimal egress rule set so it doesn't require broad internet access. We should provide an IaC snippet and a firewall checklist.

jess-integ: From integration side: we also need to version the mapping from ingestion schema -> vector DB schema. Propose a /mappings endpoint and a "X-Mapping-Version" header so we can roll out changes safely.

maria-ps: Putting a tiny example of the proxy config below to make it concrete:

```
# example proxy policy
providers:
  - name: snowflake
    method: oidc
    audience: redwood-snowbridge
    ttl: 600
  - name: databricks
    method: token_exchange
    backend: dbx-token-exchange
    ttl: 300
```

alex-eng: That helps. Follow-up: who signs off on risk for storing transient creds in the proxy? eng-security or partner legal?

maria-ps: eng-security should do the threat assessment (I already pinged @srinivasan but will copy them into the doc). Legal needs to sign the partner contract appendix (no long-lived keys).

derek-bizdev: For partner messaging, let's call it "zero-key onboarding" in the marketplace listing. Also confirm Snowflake & Databricks accept the proxy pattern for their marketplace certification (I can take point on cert requirements).

connector-bot: CI: connector-auth-proxy branch passed integration tests — https://ci.redwood/1234 ✅

tao-plat: Actionable asks: I'll prototype a VPC sidecar README + minimal terraform example by Fri. Need a sample subnet security policy from security.

jess-integ: I'll draft the mapping manifest (v1) and a JSON example of "X-Mapping-Version" usage by EOD Thu.

alex-eng: I can spike the OIDC flow with Databricks next week and loop in runtime team for KV cache implications.

derek-bizdev: I'll schedule a 30m partner sync Tue 9am PT with Snow/DBX PMs to confirm marketplace cert items.

maria-ps: Next sync: Wed 10am PT (internal). Agenda: VPC sidecar draft, OIDC spike status, mapping manifest v1, partner cert checklist. Please add anything else to the doc. :calendar: :thumbsup:
